utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That's a relief about the parking. But have we confirmed that we have enough volunteers for the whole day?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I could help out for a few hours, and maybe we can ask Gus if he's free too.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That would be great, but I still worry if we've got enough coverage for the later shifts. Maybe we should ask a couple more people.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey, Quinn! Have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday? The Smiths are collecting all sorts of broken stuff down at the community center!

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, I sure have! In fact, I've been telling everyone I know—we're going to have a great turnout with all the tools and supplies people are bringing.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That's awesome, Quinn! I'm so glad you're helping spread the word—I bet we'll have a mountain of gadgets to fix up!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, Jules, I'm so glad you mentioned it! I've got a couple of things that need fixing, and I'd love to help out.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That's awesome, Nell! We're meeting at 10 on Saturday—want to come with me and Faye?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Absolutely! I'll bring my wobbly chair and that finicky toaster. Can't wait to see everyone there.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I saw it on the community board near the park—definitely this Saturday. You should come!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh, right, Saturday — I almost forgot. I'll bring those tarps I mentioned.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, I'm glad you're bringing the tarps! I'll remind everyone else about it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I'll head over to the shed this afternoon to check the repair drive myself—can we meet there at 3?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Uh, 3? I'll try, but I might be a bit late—got a few errands to run.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: No worries, take your time—just text me when you're on your way so I can start without you.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Kira! Are you planning to join our repair drive this Saturday? We're fixing broken items together.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, a repair drive? Are you sure that's actually happening? I haven't seen any fliers or anything.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh yes, it's definitely happening! I put up fliers at the community center and the coffee shop — maybe they got taken down? It's this Saturday at 10 AM in the park pavilion.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Have you heard anything about the exact schedule for the repair drive? I want to make sure I know when to avoid the area.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Leo hasn't shared a full schedule with me yet, but I'll ask him next time I'm sorting tools and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Alright Sam, that'd be real helpful. I'll be out in my garden all morning, so just give me a shout when you hear.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh, that sounds wonderful! I've got a lamp that's been sitting broken for months—maybe this will finally get it fixed.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Have you checked the condition of the main drive yet, Faye? I need to know if it's worth pooling our money for the repair.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh, I haven't checked the main drive, Mina—I was just planning to bring my lamp to the repair drive this Saturday. Are you thinking of chipping in for something bigger?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, Opal! The repair drive... I think it's this Saturday, but I can't remember if it's morning or afternoon. I should find that sign-up sheet.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Oren, it's actually tomorrow, not Saturday. They start at 9 sharp near Elm and Birch. I'd check that sign-up sheet quickly if I were you.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, tomorrow? I could've sworn it was Saturday... Thanks for the heads-up, Opal! I need to find that sign-up sheet fast.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Noah, have you heard about the repair drive? I think Oren was putting it together.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? I think I heard something about it, but I can't recall the details. Is it definitely this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, it's this Saturday. I'm picking up the sign-up sheet from Leo – Oren left it by the mailbox. Want to help me gather volunteers?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Rey, I'd love your help sorting donations! We're gathering items at my garage on Saturday morning — could you come by?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Cleo, I can definitely swing by Saturday morning! I'll bring some extra boxes for sorting too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh Mara, that's perfect! Boxes are always needed — you're a lifesaver.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I've got that pipe wrench ready whenever you are, Rey—just say the word and I'll be over with it.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Bring it to my garage tomorrow morning, we'll put it to work.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Leo, I'll be there with the pipe wrench first thing tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, Rosa, I was just telling Noah—there's a repair drive this Saturday. I saw it on the community board near the park, so we should definitely go!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That's right, Vik! I'm so glad the word is spreading. It's going to be a great day of fixing things together—see you there!

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I'll see you there, Rosa! I'm already thinking of what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Look, if it's 9 sharp near Elm and Birch, I can plan my morning walk around that. Let's stick with that time.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Okay, 9 at Elm and Birch works. But let's confirm we have enough volunteers to handle the drop-off that early.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, that settles it for my schedule. I can help with the first shift if we’re short-handed, as long as we’re done by noon.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Don't worry, Dane. We're just getting the tools sorted out. Should be ready to start soon.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh good, I was hoping to bring my old toaster and a squeaky chair—will there be someone who can look at those?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I'm sure we can find someone to take a look at both. Let's see what we've got here.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, thanks Ira! And Eli, I think it's Saturday morning—9? No, 10? Let me just check my notes real quick.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Still not convinced this is happening without some official notice.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: You're right, Kira—I should put up a proper flyer. I'll do that today!

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Hey Rey, the repair drive is ready. Do you need it now or later?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, great! I could come by now if that works for you. Need any help setting things up?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, now works. I'll bring it over to your place in five minutes.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Ira, are you planning to help out with the repair drive this weekend? I'm rallying a few neighbors from my block.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Absolutely, Jules! I was actually about to grab the sign-up sheet by the mailbox and start rallying folks. Count me in.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Awesome, Ira! The more the merrier—I've got a couple of handy friends ready to join us too. Let's make sure we connect at the morning slot so we can all work together.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Mara, I heard you're helping out with the repair drive too. I've got plenty of tools ready if anyone needs.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That's great, Gus! We definitely need tools—maybe you can bring them by Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Saturday morning works perfect for me. I'll load up the truck and see you there.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Mina, I'm glad you're interested! We're collecting supplies for the repair drive—do you happen to have any spare tarps we could use?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I might have one or two in the garage. Did you get a look at that repair drive? Is it worth us pooling money for the fix?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, it's not about money—just sharing what we've got. A tarp or two would be a huge help, so please check your garage!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Tess, have you seen the repair crew yet? They were supposed to be near Elm and Birch this morning.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I haven't spotted them yet, but I heard the Smiths are kicking off the repair drive this Saturday—maybe that's what you're thinking of?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Saturday? No, I'm certain it's today—maybe you've got the wrong street? I've been watching Elm and Birch all morning.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? I think I saw a flyer, but I can't quite recall the date. Is it this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yes, this Saturday! Starts at 9 a.m. at the community center. We'd love to have you there!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Right, 9 a.m. at the community center. I'll make a note of it this time—thanks for confirming, Quinn.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That sounds like a great initiative, Faye. I'm already helping Leo sort tools, so we're making good progress.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great to hear, Sam! I'm planning to bring my broken lamp and help out around 10 after school drop-offs.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That's wonderful, Faye! I'll make sure Leo knows you're coming, and we'll have a spot ready for your lamp.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I'll head home now and grab those tarps — be back in a few minutes.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Wait, Dane — are you picking up tarps for the shed repair, or for something else? I want to make sure we're on the same page before you go.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh, they're for the repair drive — Cleo mentioned we need tarps to cover roofs that need patching.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
